items.label: text
items.text: Themoving-coil loudspeakeruses themotoreffect to transferelectrical energy to sound energy.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Electric currents from a source,such as a radio,pass through the coils of a speaker.

items.label: list_item
items.text: These currents,whichrepresent sounds,are always changing in size and direction,likevibrating sound waves.

items.label: list_item
items.text: The fieldsof the coiland thepermanentmagnet are therefore creating direction.

items.label: list_item
items.text: These fieldsin turn applyrapidly changing forces to thewires of the coil, which cause the speaker cone tovibrate.

items.text: Figure 21.6 A loudspeaker transfers electrical energy to sound energy.
